fields.Name: T228 - AI Agent Run Analytics Tab
fields.Description: Opens a completed AI Agent Run and switches to the Analytics tab, verifying run analytics render.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' entity grid — type 'AI Agent Runs' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' node (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=MJ:%20AI%20Agent%20Runs). Click a row whose Status is 'Completed', then click 'Open Full Record'. The AI Agent Run detail opens with a header (agent name, COMPLETED, Started/Completed/Duration/Result) and a row of tabs: Timeline, Visualization, Analytics, Details. Click the 'Analytics' tab. Verify the Analytics view renders run metrics/analytics — e.g. step counts, durations, token usage, costs, or charts summarizing the run — with no error. (Seeing analytics content render is success.) Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Completed AI Agent Run record opened
The 'Analytics' tab was selected and rendered run metrics/analytics (counts/durations/tokens/charts)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
